name: activity-island-platform
description: A cross-device information and action platform centered on a lightweight desktop island.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/platform-contracts && tsc -p packages/platform-services && tsc -p tests && npm run typecheck --workspace dynamic-island-host
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build:electron --workspace dynamic-island-host && npm run test:contract --workspace dynamic-island-host && node apps/desktop/scripts/tests/zip-unit.cjs && node --test apps/desktop/scripts/tests/settings-store.cjs apps/desktop/scripts/tests/platform-runtime.cjs apps/desktop/scripts/tests/transfer-service.cjs
